_comment: Do not add prose advice here — all text is passed verbatim to Gemini as reference data.

stages.label: Establishment
stages.description: Your trees have just been planted and are settling into the soil. Roots are growing and the tree is finding its footing.
stages.irrigation: Water every day. Give 3 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 5 grams of 19-19-19 water-soluble fertiliser per plant each week through the drip system.
stages.pest_checks: Check the base of each stem for white sticky insects or cottony patches.

stages.label: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Your trees are putting on branches and leaves. This is the main growing phase where the tree builds its shape.
stages.irrigation: Water every day. Give 4 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 7 grams of 19-19-19 water-soluble fertiliser per plant each week through the drip system.
stages.pest_checks: Look for shoot tips that are wilted or dead — this means a borer insect is inside the stem.

stages.label: Post-Monsoon Establishment
stages.description: The monsoon is ending and your trees are continuing to grow strongly. Canopy training and drainage are the main focus now.
stages.irrigation: Water every day. Give 3 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 8 grams of 12-6-20 water-soluble fertiliser per plant each week. Add 1 gram of iron chelate per plant each week.
stages.pest_checks: Check stems for bark damage from caterpillars. Clear weeds from around the base of each tree.

stages.label: Pre-Bloom Hardening
stages.description: Growth is slowing down and flower buds are beginning to form. The tree is preparing to flower.
stages.irrigation: Water every day. Give 4 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 8 grams of 8-8-32 water-soluble fertiliser per plant each week. Add 3 grams of calcium nitrate per plant each week.
stages.pest_checks: Check leaf tips for dark spots or blotches that may be early fungal disease.

stages.label: Bloom and Fruit Set
stages.description: Your trees are flowering and small fruits are forming. This is the most important time for water and nutrition.
stages.irrigation: Water every day. Give 10 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 5 grams of MKP fertiliser per plant each week in Tank B. Add 5 grams of calcium nitrate per plant each week in Tank A.
stages.pest_checks: Do not spray any insecticides this week — it will harm the bees needed for pollination. Check fruit fly traps daily.

stages.label: Fruit Development
stages.description: Fruits are sizing up rapidly. Keeping them well-fed and protected from insects is the priority.
stages.irrigation: Water every day. Give 14 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 10 grams of SOP fertiliser per plant each week. Add 3 grams of calcium nitrate per plant each week.
stages.pest_checks: Bag any fruits that are not already covered. Check bags for holes or insect entry.

stages.label: Drought Stress
stages.description: This is the deliberate dry period. Stopping water now causes all fruits to ripen together at the same time.
stages.irrigation: Stop all irrigation completely this week. Do not water at all — this is intentional and important.
stages.fertigation: No fertiliser this week. The stress period must not be interrupted.
stages.pest_checks: Check that all fruit bags are intact. Look for any fruit that has fallen early.

stages.label: Harvest
stages.description: Your fruits are ready to pick. Harvest firm-mature fruits carefully for best market quality.
stages.irrigation: Restart watering. Give 14 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 5 grams of SOP fertiliser per plant each week for 2 weeks after harvest.
stages.pest_checks: Remove all fallen fruit from the ground immediately. Burn any diseased fruit — do not compost it.

stages.label: Post-Harvest and Recovery
stages.description: Harvest is done and your trees are resting and rebuilding. New shoots are emerging from the pruned branches.
stages.irrigation: Water every day. Give 11 litres per plant each day.
stages.fertigation: Give 10 grams of 19-19-19 water-soluble fertiliser per plant each week. Add 2 grams of humic acid per plant each week.
stages.pest_checks: Watch new shoots carefully for borer insects. Check the root area for any signs of wilting or rotting.
